say:2:1033347001:1.text: As we have discussed before, since we can't get these herbs out, we are gonna to offer them to the refugees at the entrance to the forest.
say:2:1033347001:1.source_cn: 之前商量的，要把积攒着无法转运出去的草药先分发给丛林入...
say:2:1033347001:1.male: As we have discussed before, since we can't get these herbs out, we are gonna to offer them to the refugees at the entrance to the forest.
say:2:1033347001:1.female: As we have discussed before, since we can't get these herbs out, we are gonna to offer them to the refugees at the entrance to the forest.

say:3:1033347002:1.text: Look. Members of the Dusk Patrollers came to help with the transport.
say:3:1033347002:1.source_cn: 你看，薄暮巡游队的队员来协助搬运药箱了。
say:3:1033347002:1.male: Look. Members of the Dusk Patrollers came to help with the transport.
say:3:1033347002:1.female: Look. Members of the Dusk Patrollers came to help with the transport.

say:4:1033347003:1.text: At last, our hard work is put to good use!
say:4:1033347003:1.source_cn: 也算对得起我们的劳动了……之前的工作，都没白费！
say:4:1033347003:1.male: At last, our hard work is put to good use!
say:4:1033347003:1.female: At last, our hard work is put to good use!
